description: HRRR-Smoke's smoke: one transported aerosol mass mixing ratio, emitted by satellite-observed fires with Freitas plume rise, taken in from HRRR at the boundaries, mixed, deposited and washed out.

rows.name: smoke
rows.long_name: smoke (fire PM2.5) mass mixing ratio per dry air

emissions.provenance: RAVE's own hourly fire PM2.5 emission (kg per cell per hour) is the smoke source mass, as DESIGN 5.2 chose; RRFS-SD instead forms it from FRE with a vegetation emission-factor map (see the rave-3km source row); weight 1 because smoke is PM2.5 mass.

boundary.provenance: Operational HRRR v4.1.21 smoke lateral boundaries: RAP awp130bgrb MASSDEN through real.exe (exhrrr_makebc.sh, hrrr_vtable, registry.smoke smoke_gc). Edge values only (frames boundary), so with both sources enabled the start state is HRRR's own smoke (hrrr-native-smoke, below) and the edges are RAP's, as operational HRRR.
HRRR-Smoke's own smoke on its 50 hybrid levels (wrfnat MASSDEN, 0/20/0, level type 105), turned back into ug/kg with the density UPP multiplied by (see the hrrr-native-smoke source row).

optics.from: Bulk fire PM2.5 is represented as hydrophilic organic particulate matter using WRF-Chem module_optical_averaging.F:3928-4016 size modes and the MERRA organic aerosol table. Unit mass multiplier: this tracer is particulate mass already, not organic carbon. Unresolved soot and brown-carbon composition is not inferred; use resolved GOCART carbon rows when composition is required.

radiation.provenance: HRRR v4.1.21 WRFV3.9 fork: smoke/module_add_emiss_burn.F:186-194 forms aod3d_smoke = 1e-6 * (4.0 + 0.5 m2/g) * smoke (ug/kg) * 1/ALT (dry density, smoke/chem_driver.F:200) * dz8w; phys/module_radiation_driver.F:979-984 adds MIN(3, aod3d_smoke) to the aer_opt = 3 layer AOD when chem_opt = 18 and simple_dir_fdb = 1. Read only with the run's simple_dir_fdb = 1.

rows.provenance: WRF Registry/registry.chem:2120 (state smoke in the tracer array, package tracer_smoke tracer_opt==1 at :4177); units ug kg-1 per dry air as HRRR-Smoke carries it (UPP inverts MASSDEN from it). floor = WRF epsilc 1.E-16. default_inflow 0: with no boundary source enabled no smoke enters, and the run receipt says smoke from outside the domain is absent (DESIGN 5.1). wetdep_ls_alpha 0.5 is GSL's wetdep_ls_alpha default (gsl-ccpp-physics/physics/smoke_dust/rrfs_smoke_config.F90:40), a data choice. Dry deposition joins the row ({scheme: gocart_aerosol} with the process drydep.gocart) when the aq-gocart lane's module is in the build.
